title: Session detail -- Swim
description: One swimming session, selected by clicking a row of a sessions table. The link passes the session's own time window. A pool swim has NO per-second samples: the watch emits length messages instead, so the swim lengths table is the fine-grained view and the sample panels only fill in for open water.

list.name: activity_id
list.query: SELECT aw.activity_id AS __value, to_char(aw.start_time_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  ' || coalesce(aw.name, aw.sport) AS __text FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = aw.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'swim' ORDER BY aw.local_date DESC LIMIT 200
list.definition: SELECT aw.activity_id AS __value, to_char(aw.start_time_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  ' || coalesce(aw.name, aw.sport) AS __text FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = aw.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'swim' ORDER BY aw.local_date DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Session
panels.description: Identity and totals from mart.activity_wide: date, sport, name, data quality, elapsed duration and distance. For a pool swim, duration is the whole session including rest at the wall.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(aw.local_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date", aw.sport AS "Sport", aw.name AS "Name", aw.data_quality AS "Data quality", CASE WHEN aw.duration_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (aw.duration_s::int / 3600)::text || ':' || lpad(((((aw.duration_s::int) % 3600) / 60))::text, 2, '0') || ':' || lpad(((aw.duration_s::int) % 60)::text, 2, '0') END AS "Duration", aw.distance_m / 1000.0 AS "Distance", CASE WHEN aw.swim_time_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (aw.swim_time_s::int / 3600)::text || ':' || lpad(((((aw.swim_time_s::int) % 3600) / 60))::text, 2, '0') || ':' || lpad(((aw.swim_time_s::int) % 60)::text, 2, '0') END AS "Active swim" FROM mart.activity_wide aw WHERE aw.activity_id = $activity_id

panels.title: Load & derived
panels.description: Training load and derived metrics from mart.activity_wide. Swim sTSS and IF divide by ACTIVE swim time (rebuilt from pool lengths, rest excluded), never by elapsed duration: elapsed time overstates sTSS by 30-50% on interval sets.

targets.rawSql: SELECT aw.tss AS "TSS", aw.tss_method AS "TSS method", aw.intensity_factor AS "IF", aw.trimp AS "TRIMP" FROM mart.activity_wide aw WHERE aw.activity_id = $activity_id

panels.title: Stroke metrics
panels.description: Per-length averages rebuilt from core.swim_length, active lengths only. SWOLF is the watch's efficiency heuristic (length time + strokes): lower is 'better', but it trades off pace and strokes so read it as a trend, not a target.

targets.rawSql: SELECT aw.avg_hr AS "Avg HR", aw.max_hr AS "Max HR", CASE WHEN aw.distance_m > 0 AND aw.swim_time_s IS NOT NULL THEN (aw.swim_time_s * 100.0 / aw.distance_m / 60)::int::text || ':' || lpad(round((aw.swim_time_s * 100.0 / aw.distance_m)::numeric % 60)::int::text, 2, '0') END AS "Avg pace", count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active') AS "Active lengths", round(avg(l.duration_s) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active')::numeric, 1) AS "Avg length (s)", round(avg(l.total_strokes) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active')::numeric, 1) AS "Avg strokes", round(avg(l.duration_s + l.total_strokes) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active')::numeric, 0) AS "SWOLF" FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id LEFT JOIN core.swim_length l ON l.activity_id = a.activity_id WHERE aw.activity_id = $activity_id GROUP BY aw.avg_hr, aw.max_hr, aw.swim_time_s, aw.distance_m

panels.title: Pace & heart rate
panels.description: Pool: pace per active length, rebuilt from core.swim_length -- pool length is inferred as activity distance divided by the number of active lengths, so it holds for 25 m as well as 50 m pools. Pace is displayed as clock time per 100 m (00:01:50 = 1:50/100 m, the way Garmin spells it). The dashed line is the session average (swim time / distance), the number to compare against CSS. Open water: no length messages, so the bar chart is empty and the per-second pace on the right axis takes over (clock time per 100 m, converted from speed; samples under 0.2 m/s excluded -- auto-pause/drift spikes). Remember pace inverts: a lower point is a FASTER swim. Heart rate shares the LEFT axis with the pool bars.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.start_time AS time, (l.duration_s * 100.0 * len.n / NULLIF(a.distance_m, 0)) AS "Pace (/100 m)" FROM core.swim_length l JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = l.activity_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.length_type = 'active') AS n FROM core.swim_length s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id) len WHERE l.activity_id = $activity_id AND l.length_type = 'active' ORDER BY 1

WITH b AS (SELECT min(l.start_time) AS t0, max(l.start_time) AS t1 FROM core.swim_length l WHERE l.activity_id = $activity_id AND l.length_type = 'active') SELECT b.t0 AS time, (a.swim_time_s * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.distance_m, 0)) AS "Session avg" FROM b JOIN core.activity a ON true UNION ALL SELECT b.t1, (a.swim_time_s * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.distance_m, 0)) FROM b JOIN core.activity a ON true
SELECT s.t AS time, 100.0 / NULLIF(s.speed_mps, 0) AS "OW pace (/100 m)" FROM core.sample s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id AND s.speed_mps > 0.2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT s.t AS time, s.heart_rate AS "HR (bpm)" FROM core.sample s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id AND s.heart_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time in HR zones
panels.description: Seconds per HR zone, bounds in PERCENT OF MAX HR as requested: Z1 <60%, Z2 60-70%, Z3 70-80%, Z4 80-90%, Z5 >=90%. Max HR comes from core.threshold (discipline 'all', valid at the session date) and falls back to the session's own recorded max HR when no threshold row exists. Note: hrTSS itself stays computed on %LTHR (Friel zones); this panel is a display bucket only. Empty when the session carries no HR data.

targets.rawSql: WITH th AS (SELECT coalesce(t.hr_max_bpm, aw.max_hr) AS hrmax FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.hr_max_bpm FROM core.threshold t WHERE t.athlete_id = a.athlete_id AND t.discipline = 'all' AND t.validity @> a.local_date AND t.hr_max_bpm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) t ON true WHERE aw.activity_id = $activity_id), b AS (SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Z1 <60%' AS zone, 0.0::real AS lo, 0.60::real AS hi UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Z2 60-70%', 0.60, 0.70 UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Z3 70-80%', 0.70, 0.80 UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Z4 80-90%', 0.80, 0.90 UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Z5 >=90%', 0.90, 9.99) SELECT b.zone AS "Zone", coalesce(sum(h.seconds), 0) AS "Seconds" FROM b CROSS JOIN th LEFT JOIN core.activity_hr_histogram h ON h.activity_id = $activity_id AND h.hr_bpm >= (b.lo * th.hrmax) AND h.hr_bpm < (b.hi * th.hrmax) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.activity_hr_histogram x WHERE x.activity_id = $activity_id) GROUP BY b.ord, b.zone ORDER BY b.ord

panels.title: Swim lengths
panels.description: core.swim_length, one row per pool length. This is the only fine-grained data that exists for pool swims: idle lengths are rest at the wall, and active-length time is what swim sTSS and IF are built on.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.length_index AS "Length", l.length_type AS "Type", l.swim_stroke AS "Stroke", l.duration_s AS "Time (s)", l.total_strokes AS "Strokes", l.avg_cadence AS "Strokes/min" FROM core.swim_length l WHERE l.activity_id = $activity_id ORDER BY l.length_index

panels.title: GPS track -- speed
panels.description: GPS track colored by speed. Downsampled to 5 s. Empty for pool swims: pool swimming records no per-second samples. GPS points only for open water.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.latitude_deg AS "lat", s.longitude_deg AS "lon", s.speed_mps AS "Speed (m/s)"
FROM core.sample s
WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id
  AND s.latitude_deg IS NOT NULL AND s.longitude_deg IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (s.latitude_deg = 0 AND s.longitude_deg = 0)
  AND s.elapsed_s % 5 = 0
ORDER BY s.t
